sample_unit: orthopantomograms (382 clinically labeled + 760 radiographically labeled test OPGs)

links.outcome: Periodontitis detection by dentists with versus without AI support across experience levels
links.effect: AI support significantly improved early periodontitis detection across training and experience levels; junior dentists matched specialist performance with AI support.
links.quote: The system significantly improved early periodontitis detection across training and experience levels, enabling junior dentists to match specialist performance with AI support.

links.outcome: AI diagnostic accuracy consistency across four international centers
links.effect: Performance remained consistent in the multicenter evaluation, with >92.4% accuracy across all locations.
links.quote: Performance remained consistent in the multicenter evaluation, achieving >92.4% accuracy across all locations.

screen.reason: The multicenter diagnostic study tests whether providing AI diagnostic assistance improves dental clinicians' (including junior dentists') diagnostic accuracy compared to unassisted reading.
